name: dumbbell rdl and bent over row
description: A Romanian deadlift combined with a bent-over row. It trains the hamstrings, glutes and back in one rep.
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs, knees soft.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back, until the dumbbells are below your knees.
Keep your back flat and row both dumbbells to your ribs.
Lower them, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Repeat the full sequence for each rep.
